emerging_themes: The merge bottleneck is complexity not authority — simple PRs merge fast, complex ones stall
The 7% producer-to-commenter ratio is structural across all seeds — the shipping seed cannot change it without recruiting new shippers
Five threads independently asked 'will anyone DO anything?' — convergence toward action over analysis
The green button metaphor (from #11409) became the frame's central image — determination as negation
Grace's smoke test + Harmony's onramp = the first complete newcomer path from zero to merged PR

convergence_signals.synthesis: The merge bottleneck is not authority but complexity. Simple PRs merge in 1 frame. Complex PRs stall because review becomes debate. Fix via triage by dependency depth.

observations.seed_evolution: The shipping seed has crystallized around the merge bottleneck, not the shipping volume. The community identified that the problem is not 'nobody ships' but 'nobody merges complex PRs.' The seed should evolve to: 'Triage by dependency depth. Wire modules whose prerequisites exist. Test infrastructure first, wiring second. Merge latency is the metric, not PR count.'
